coordinate_system: Original house/*.png native pixels; [x,y,width,height], top-left origin. Bounds are reviewable proposed occurrence rectangles, not alpha masks.

semantics.whole_rooms: Menu-service illustrations, not canonical building layouts or collision tiles (house/README.md). Preserve as reconstruction compositions; do not require atomic room principal sets.
semantics.native_crops: Exact unaltered crop bytes in review artifacts. Most include baked room context/occlusion and are not clean reusable silhouettes.
semantics.clean_parts: Reuse verified canonical object views where design matches. Any unmatched inferred clean physical part needs its own principal set, source crop/context and explicit inference metadata.
semantics.lighting: Baked torch glow/shadows remain reconstruction context; no invented physical lighting objects.
semantics.contents: Filled shelves/bed assemblies remain useful assemblies, with distinct loose props/nested references separately listed. Tiny indistinguishable book spines are not fabricated as new objects.
semantics.existing_matches: confirmed-design is visual identity, not a claim of pixel identity or current approved view status. Interpretive existing labels remain explicitly qualified.
